title: Humor Genome Wave 2: reproducible humor-structure research and integration toolkit
description: A public research release and deployable toolkit for studying humor structure without treating model surprisal as funniness. Includes rights-filtered data, executable Kaggle studies, deterministic CC0 controls, adversarial and multimodal contracts, human-study launch tooling, provider-neutral integrations, an API, and deployment manifests.
notes: Version pinned to 0.7.0 deliberately: the archive deposit target is the frozen v0.7.0 tag whose per-file inventory is CI-verified (docs/DOI_ARCHIVE.md); the application release is 0.8.0.
